Subject: Post-call recap & next step: technical immersion (60-90m)

Tom — great to speak earlier. Quick recap and proposed next step so we can get engineering time on the calendar.

Why OrbitWorks engaged (recap)
- Heavy inference costs at 2M tokens/day; spikes causing throttled pipelines.
- Need deterministic latency for real-time annotation (<= 120ms tail).
- Interested in private deployment options / VPC + KMS for data residency.

Suggested next step
- 60–90 minute technical immersion with our ML infra and platform engineers to:
  1) walk through service architecture and routing policies,
  2) review batching/cache patterns and quantization options,
  3) discuss deployment options (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and SLOs,
  4) identify quick wins and mutual action plan.

Proposed attendees (from our side)
- Ben Carter (AE) — myself (facilitate + AM context)
- Marissa Cole (Customer Success) — ops/rollout + success metrics
- Lauren Bishop (Solutions Engineer) — technical run and demo

Proposed windows (PST) — pick one that fits your team:
- Thursday 2027-11-09 09:00–10:30
- Thursday 2027-11-09 13:00–14:30
- Monday 2027-11-13 11:00–12:30

Attached: proposed-agenda.md (light outline). If none of these work, send two windows that work for your ML/infra folks and security lead. Also flag any additional topics you want covered (e.g., audit logs, retention policy).

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
